nom: Dermalogica Clear Start Clearing Defense Moisturizer SPF 30

segments.oily: Many reviewers with oily to very oily skin report a matte, non-greasy finish and no added shine, though a few say it still left them oily or that a reformulated batch stopped mattifying.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry/combination skin are split, some finding it light and hydrating while others describe it as overly drying, stinging, and prone to pilling on dry patches.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly describe it as light with a slight glow and no oily feel, though one combination-skin reviewer says it did not wear well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several say it is the first sunscreen that doesn't sting their eyes or irritate their skin, while others report burning, tingling, or eye stinging from the fragrance and chemical filter.
segments.mature: One reviewer nearing 40 says it is her first daily SPF that works well and gives an easy makeup base.

concerns.aging: One reviewer approaching 40 adopted it as her first workable daily SPF; another notes it helps keep existing dark spots from darkening and prevents new ones.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it feels light and non-drying or even hydrating, but others report it dried their skin out, caused stinging, and worsened pilling on dry patches.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes no redness or irritation; no other reviewer discusses redness directly.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive/reactive skin mostly report no burning or eye-sting, but a subset describes burning, tingling, and eye irritation lasting up to an hour after application.
concerns.spots: Users on acne treatments or with acne-prone skin frequently say it works well over topical acne medication and doesn't worsen breakouts, though a couple mention occasional whiteheads or mild breakouts, especially with prolonged daily wear.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in existing blemishes; a minority describe continued or new breakouts, including one report of it making breakouts worse.
concerns.oiliness: The large majority of oily-skin reviewers say it controls shine and mattifies well under makeup all day; a few report it left their skin greasy or oily, and one long-time user says a newer tube batch no longer mattifies as before.

extraits.texte: For the most part, this doesn't break me out. I have dry/combo, sensitive acne-prone skin, and some days I'll have a few whiteheads by the end of the day. It has a noticeable sunscreen/lemon or citrus scent. It dries quickly, but unfortunately, it often pills. After a few hours, I often notice a sunscreen taste in my mouth.

I've been using this sunscreen for monyhs now. Im on my 4th bottle and I absolutely love it! I have extremely oily skin that's very sensitive. This product not only goes on like a dream and absorbs quickly(which is great for my inpatient rushes lol.) But it also helps mattify under primer and control my oily skin a bit. Now does it completely stop oil breakthroughs No! But lets be real there isn't a single matte or oil free product that will. It takes a routine and work if your skin is like mine. But now I'm being recommended to use physical(mineral) sunscreen due to my melasma. I'm struggling to find one that will work for my skin type and hating letting this one go! Highly recommend this product if you want a good matte, sheer, daily sunscreen.

extraits.titre: Works Great with Acne Topical Ointment
extraits.texte: This sunscreen has been my go-to for AWHILE. This is the ONLY sunscreen Ive tried that works well with my acne medications and routine - particularly with Azelaic Acid. All other sunscreens Ive tried with this have made my skin feel disgustingly sticky and oily. This sunscreen is the only one which doesnt make me feel gross or sticky. Another plus, I use a generous amount daily but it lasts FOREVER. I only have to purchase 2-3x a year maybe. I have extremely sensitive skin and its lightweight and gentle enough to not irritate my skin. I like that it doesnt really mattify or suck the moisture out of my skin like some other sunscreens feel. Definitely recommend to those on topical acne meds - it's a game-changer.

I bought this sunscreen on accident because I thought it was a free gift and didn't check until I picked it up in store. However, I decided to use it because I needed a new sunscreen and surprisingly, this worked very well for me. I have extremely sensitive skin and it sits on top of my other skin care products very well. This is also the first sunscreen that hasn't irritated my skin or burned my eyes which I truly appreciate because every sunscreen I've worn in the past had an extremely painful reaction on my eyes. I plan on repurchasing.

I have acne prone/ oily and sensitive skin so i always struggle to find something that works for me but let me tell you I loveeeee this one. It absorbed into my skin and left it moisturized/ glowy but not oily at all. However, it does have a very light sunscreen smell but I really don't mind that because of how good it feels on my skin.

I've always hated wearing daily SPF but now pushing 40 I know I need to! This is amazing. It IS matte just as the name suggests and it's easy to apply makeup on top. It has a slight sunscreen smell but not terrible and doesn't run into my eyes and stingy. I've not experienced any breakouts from it. Super happy with this purchase!

This feels very overly drying even layered on top of the circular hydration serum and moisturizer. And feels slightly stinging even a few hours later. It's very very matte and strong smelling and unpleasant. It smells of thyme. Wanted to love this because of the ingredients and reviews and my skin type has all the concerns this claims to target. Alas, I continue my search for an SPF.
